captures.name: sysmon-masquerade-primary
captures.background_manifest: Ubuntu MOTD resolved through its pre-guard public resolver and opened HTTPS while Sysmon was being re-homed; no declared-tool attribution existed for those rows. The capture is retained in the safety manifest and was not filtered.

c2.interpretation: The JA3/JA3S pair is identical to the Sliver Linux Go TLS pair already present in this repository and is therefore a cross-family Go crypto/tls characteristic, not an Adaptix signature. No duplicate rule was authored.

periodicity.reason: The official Linux Gopher agent reports sleep=0/jitter=0 and keeps a continuous task connection. Its configured 10 seconds is reconnect delay, not a Beacon interval.

dns.sliver_comparison: Both frameworks use Base32-like multi-label DNS and benefit from source/domain-independent correlation. Sliver's observed v1.7.3 profile had two 63-character labels plus an 18-63-character label and steady 10.212-13.521-second burst gaps. The Adaptix listener validation had fixed hex metadata labels and a 20-character heartbeat data label. The current captures do not justify collapsing the two expressions; a broader cross-family rule needs genuine Adaptix agent traffic and additional benign DNS-tunnel comparison.
